description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ModelDataTable' which renders a data table with features like sorting, resizing, and column visibility controls. It imports external libraries such as @tanstack/react-table for table logic and @tremor/react for UI components, and uses @heroicons/react for icons. It also extends the react-table's ColumnMeta interface to include a className property.

classes.name: ModelDataTableProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the props accepted by the ModelDataTable component, including data array, columns definitions, loading state, table reference, and default sorting.

methods.name: ModelDataTable
methods.description: React functional component that creates a customizable, sortable, resizable data table with optional loading state and column visibility controls.
